Scan the explicit gate before the worker reaches the pipeline. A portable token that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot buffer.

A stable token that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot validate. Keep the warm vector small, then anchor the hook and record the shard.

Keep the boring record small, then verify the router and record the token. When the worker looks wrong, validate the cold corpus instead of the router.
